Pralhad Joshi Appointed New Union Education Minister

Pralhad Joshi, currently the Union Minister for Food and Consumer Affairs, has been given the additional charge of the Ministry of Education. This appointment follows the resignation of Dharmendra Pradhan. Joshi, a five-time Member of Parliament, has stated his commitment to fulfilling the responsibilities entrusted to him.
